mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_SEQ AS userSeq, A.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, A.USER_TYPE AS userType, CONCAT(A.USER_NM,'(',A.USER_ID,')') AS userNm, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.COMMENT AS comment, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT B.USER_EMAIL ORDER BY B.USER_EMAIL SEPARATOR ',') AS userEmail, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT C.USER_IP ORDER BY C.USER_IP SEPARATOR ',') AS userIp FROM UI_INTEREST_USERS A LEFT JOIN UI_INTEREST_USER_EMAIL B ON A.USER_SEQ = B.USER_SEQ LEFT JOIN UI_INTEREST_USER_IP C ON A.USER_SEQ = C.USER_SEQ WHERE A.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} GROUP BY A.USER_SEQ, A.ADMIN_ID, A.USER_TYPE, A.USER_NM, A.USER_ID, A.COMMENT ORDER BY USER_NM

SELECT A.USER_SEQ AS userSeq, A.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, A.USER_TYPE AS userType, A.USER_NM AS userNm, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.COMMENT AS comment, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT B.USER_EMAIL ORDER BY B.USER_EMAIL SEPARATOR ' ') AS userEmail, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT C.USER_IP ORDER BY C.USER_IP SEPARATOR ' ') AS userIp FROM UI_INTEREST_USERS A LEFT JOIN UI_INTEREST_USER_EMAIL B ON A.USER_SEQ = B.USER_SEQ LEFT JOIN UI_INTEREST_USER_IP C ON A.USER_SEQ = C.USER_SEQ WHERE A.USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} GROUP BY A.USER_SEQ, A.ADMIN_ID, A.USER_TYPE, A.USER_NM, A.USER_ID, A.COMMENT LIMIT 1

SELECT A.USER_SEQ AS userSeq, A.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, A.USER_TYPE AS userType, A.USER_NM AS userNm, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.COMMENT AS comment, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT B.USER_EMAIL ORDER BY B.USER_EMAIL SEPARATOR ' ') AS userEmail, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT C.USER_IP ORDER BY C.USER_IP SEPARATOR ' ') AS userIp FROM UI_INTEREST_USERS A LEFT JOIN UI_INTEREST_USER_EMAIL B ON A.USER_SEQ = B.USER_SEQ LEFT JOIN UI_INTEREST_USER_IP C ON A.USER_SEQ = C.USER_SEQ WHERE A.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} GROUP BY A.USER_SEQ, A.ADMIN_ID, A.USER_TYPE, A.USER_NM, A.USER_ID, A.COMMENT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_INTEREST_USERS (USER_SEQ, ADMIN_ID, USER_TYPE, USER_NM, USER_ID, COMMENT) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{adminId}, #{userType}, #{userNm}, #{userId}, #{comment})
mapper.update: UPDATE UI_CONF_ADMIN SET VAL = '' WHERE CONF_ID = 'interestUser.user' AND FIND_IN_SET(VAL, #{userSeq})
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(USER_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),0)+1 AS userSeq FROM UI_INTEREST_USERS

SELECT GROUP_SEQ AS groupSeq , GROUP_NAME AS groupName FROM UI_ADMIN_USER_GROUP WHERE 1 = 1
AND GROUP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
ORDER BY GROUP_SEQ

SELECT A.USER_ID AS userId, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT
CAST(if(B.USER_EMAIL is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, B.USER_EMAIL)) AS CHAR)
B.USER_EMAIL
ORDER BY B.USER_EMAIL SEPARATOR ', ') AS userEmail, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT (C.USER_IP) ORDER BY INET6_ATON(C.USER_IP) SEPARATOR ', ') AS userIp FROM UI_ADMIN_USER_GROUP_LIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_USER_EMAIL B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_USER_IP C ON A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE FIND_IN_SET(A.GROUP_SEQ, #{groupCodes}) GROUP BY A.USER_ID

SELECT A.GROUP_SEQ AS groupSeq, GROUP_NAME AS groupName, C.USER_ID AS userId, C.USER_NM AS userNm, B.GROUP_COLOR AS groupColor FROM UI_ADMIN_USER_GROUP_LIST A, UI_ADMIN_USER_GROUP B, UI_USERS C WHERE A.GROUP_SEQ = B.GROUP_SEQ AND A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}
